title: Madras HC issues notice to CM Vijay, Minister Aadhav Arjuna on petitions challenging their election wins
description: The Madras High Court on Tuesday issued notice to Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay and Minister Aadhav Arjuna in elections petitions challenging their 2026 Assembly election victories.Justice V Lakshminarayanan issued notice on the petitions challenging Vijay’s victories from Perambur and Tiruchirappalli East.
